traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Tetramelaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire or dentate; veins palmate; blades ovate; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup present; stems woody; flowers in panicles or in spikes; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals or tepals; fruit capsule; stamens 4 to 8; carpels 4 to 8. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
